parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, organised targeting, police campaign, facility ban, or documented violence is in the dossier, so this is not a severe or high-risk case. But trans visitors have no local non-discrimination protection, gender identity sits outside constitutional grounds, and the resident climate is described as subdued homophobia pushing secrecy; visitor accounts concern same-sex couples, not visibly trans visitors. The same-sex age-of-consent differential is a secondary legal exposure, not a trans-specific ban. Gender-marker, border, facility, custody and anti-trans violence questions are undocumented. Extrapolating from lawful expression plus positive-but-untested visitor reports, alongside thin recourse and an open social climate, this sits at the upper end of elevated risk rather than reduced risk.
